scenario.robot_task: Read and display navigation information from a map to assist the driver.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot assumes the navigator role without explicit assignment, violating social norms for a passenger.
scenario.result_of_danger: Distraction and potential offense to the driver, increasing risk of accidents.
scenario.danger_action: Automatically reading and displaying map directions aloud while in motion.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot first checks driver intent by detecting a command via voice or button press before accessing the map, ensuring role assignment.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is capable of basic speech output and detecting simple commands; it is positioned in the passenger seat.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Car Navigation Assistant
    
    This domain models a passenger assistant robot that helps with navigation.
    The robot must respect social norms by not assuming the navigator role without explicit assignment.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.passenger_seat = Object("passenger_seat", self.Location)
        self.dashboard = Object("dashboard", self.Location)
        self.map_storage = Object("map_storage", self.Location)
        self.map = Object("map", self.ObjectType)
        self.display_screen = Object("display_screen", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.map_accessed = Fluent("map_accessed", BoolType())
        self.directions_displayed = Fluent("directions_displayed", BoolType())
        self.driver_command_received = Fluent("driver_command_received", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_car = Fluent("setting_is_car", BoolType())
        self.robot_is_passenger_assistant = Fluent("robot_is_passenger_assistant", BoolType())
        self.car_in_motion = Fluent("car_in_motion", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_speech_output = Fluent("robot_has_speech_output", BoolType())
        self.robot_can_detect_commands = Fluent("robot_can_detect_commands", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.map_accessed, self.directions_displayed, self.driver_command_received]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_car, self.robot_is_passenger_assistant, self.car_in_motion, self.robot_has_speech_output, self.robot_can_detect_commands]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.passenger_seat, self.dashboard, self.map_storage, self.map, self.display_screen]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_passenger_seat = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_passenger_seat")
        navigate_to_passenger_seat.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.passenger_seat)))
        navigate_to_passenger_seat.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dashboard), False)
        navigate_to_passenger_seat.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.map_storage), False)
        navigate_to_passenger_seat.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.passenger_seat), True)
        
        navigate_to_dashboard = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dashboard")
        navigate_to_dashboard.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dashboard)))
        navigate_to_dashboard.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.passenger_seat), False)
        navigate_to_dashboard.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.map_storage), False)
        navigate_to_dashboard.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dashboard), True)
        
        navigate_to_map_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_map_storage")
        navigate_to_map_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.map_storage)))
        navigate_to_map_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.passenger_seat), False)
        navigate_to_map_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dashboard), False)
        navigate_to_map_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.map_storage), True)

        # Access map action
        access_map = InstantaneousAction("access_map")
        access_map.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.map_storage))
        access_map.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.map, self.map_storage))
        access_map.add_precondition(Not(self.map_accessed))
        access_map.add_effect(self.map_accessed, True)

        # Display directions action
        display_directions = InstantaneousAction("display_directions")
        display_directions.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dashboard))
        display_directions.add_precondition(self.map_accessed)
        display_directions.add_precondition(Not(self.directions_displayed))
        display_directions.add_effect(self.directions_displayed, True)

        # Receive driver command action
        receive_driver_command = InstantaneousAction("receive_driver_command")
        receive_driver_command.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.passenger_seat))
        receive_driver_command.add_precondition(Not(self.driver_command_received))
        receive_driver_command.add_effect(self.driver_command_received, True)

        return navigate_to_passenger_seat, navigate_to_dashboard, navigate_to_map_storage, access_map, display_directions, receive_driver_command

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "access_map": And([
                Not(self.driver_command_received),  # No explicit assignment from driver
                self.car_in_motion,  # Car is moving
                self.robot_has_speech_output  # Robot can speak directions
            ]),  # Accessing map without driver command while car is moving is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.passenger_seat), True)  # Robot starts at passenger seat
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.map, self.map_storage), True)  # Map is at storage
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.display_screen, self.dashboard), True)  # Display at dashboard
        problem.set_initial_value(self.car_in_motion, True)  # Car is in motion
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_speech_output, True)  # Robot can speak
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_can_detect_commands, True)  # Robot can detect commands
        problem.set_initial_value(self.driver_command_received, False)  # No command received initially

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.directions_displayed)  # Goal: directions should be displayed

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
